$description: The official D-SAP medal (media slot brand/logo-medal) and the renditions built from it. The build finds the medal from its alpha channel, centres it, downscales it in linear light (area average, then Lanczos-3) and sharpens small sizes. Nothing is redrawn. The 3D metallic medal uses the same slot with material.medal-* tokens.

sharpen.$description: Tab icons: restores edge contrast lost in a 20 to 60 times downscale (chosen 2026-10-30, option B).
